description: Walk along the hexagonal spiral, with its cells numbered starting at 0, as in A395362. Three players, Black, Cyan, and Red, take turns. When it is Black's's turn, he places a (Glinski) queen at the smallest unoccupied cell not attacked by an existing Cyan or Red queen; when it is Cyan's turn, he places a queen at the smallest unoccupied cell not attacked by an existing Black or Red queen, and when it is Red's turn, he places a queen at the smallest unoccupied cell not attacked by an existing Black or Cyan queen. Sequence lists cells occupied by Red queens.
